description: The main window, by the label MAIN_WINDOW in src/lib.rs; rename both together. Grants the twenty-four bridge commands of src/commands.rs, one permission each (docs/decisions/0012-desktop-bridge.md, docs/decisions/0019-app-stream-to-the-window.md, open_external, open_file and reveal in docs/decisions/0026-open-and-reveal.md, open_settings in docs/decisions/0028-settings-window.md, and setup in docs/decisions/0048-signin-on-the-wire.md, whose allow-list per window is in src/setup/admit.rs, and the folder chooser's pick_folder_or_choose, chooser_starts, chooser_list, chooser_choose and chooser_cancel in src/chooser.rs; chooser_shown and page_marks, which only log the page's timing (src/startup.rs); and quit_app, which takes no arguments and quits the app as Cmd+Q does, through the stop steps and the sign-in cancel, for the Get the installer button in src/commands.rs; and open_privacy_settings, which takes no arguments and opens only macOS's Files and Folders privacy pane, for the Open Privacy settings button under matter.folder_permission, in src/commands.rs), and the two window commands of Tauri's drag script for the room's title bar, DRAG_PERMISSIONS in src/window_frame.rs (docs/decisions/0015-window-frame.md). Nothing else: every permission widens what script in the page can reach.
